name: Grunbach
source:
"Now, come here. I came here to set you free."

A mysterious gentleman who suddenly appears at the Ryuukyuu LAG headquarters.
He talks and acts in a grandiose way and gives off a feeling of being disconnected to the world.
He calls the protagonist his 'little bird' and seems strangely attached to her.
